title: Critical Path Task Age
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:gantt phase_name=* critical_open=*
| stats sum(eval(if(critical_open="yes",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by phase_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending open critical-path tasks backlog by phase for critical path management.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside critical path management.
implementation: Mark each `reno:gantt` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `phase_name`.
visualization: Table of phase with pending open critical-path tasks counts.
grandmaExplanation: It measures where unfinished open critical-path tasks are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in critical path management.
